title: Meshy+Unity : From Text to Game in Under 1 Hour
author: Soliloquis
selftext: This is a video breakdown of a process I'm using to get characters from Meshy to Unity in under 1 hour. All of the wait times for task execution have been removed showing that the entire process can actually be done in less than 20 minutes.

replies.author: Soliloquis
replies.body: Agreed, this has been a boon to getting my tech demo up and running.
